import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def fasta(acc):
    r=requests.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta',timeout=60); r.raise_for_status()
    L=r.text.strip().split('\n'); return ''.join(L[1:])

PANEL=[
 # label, acc, experimentally determined specificity, evidence note
 ('pig SUCLG2 (G-SCS)','P53590','GTP-specific','purified enzyme + structures 2FP4/7JJ0'),
 ('human SUCLG2 (G-SCS)','Q96I99','GTP-specific','purified/recombinant'),
 ('mouse Suclg2','Q9Z2I8','GTP-specific','orthology to characterised G-SCS'),
 ('pig SUCLA2 (A-SCS)','O97580','ATP-specific','purified enzyme'),
 ('human SUCLA2 (A-SCS)','Q9P2R7','ATP-specific','recombinant SUCLG1-SUCLA2'),
 ('mouse Sucla2','Q9Z2I9','ATP-specific','orthology to characterised A-SCS'),
 ('S. cerevisiae LSC2','P53312','ADP-forming (ATP)','yeast SCS is ADP-forming'),
 ('E. coli SucC','P0A836','dual, prefers ADP/ATP','Joyce 2012 comparison; 1CQI'),
 ('T. aquaticus SucC','A0ABN4IHZ4','dual, prefers GDP/GTP','PMID 22751660; 3UFX'),
 ('Dicty scsC (Q55AI5)','Q55AI5','UNKNOWN','target'),
 ('Dicty scsB (Q869S7)','Q869S7','UNKNOWN','paralogue'),
]
S={}
for lab,acc,_,_ in PANEL:
    try: S[lab]=fasta(acc)
    except Exception as e: print('ERR',lab,acc,e)

# 2FP4 chain B reference
pdb=requests.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/2FP4.pdb',timeout=120).text
aa3to1={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L',
'LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','NEP':'H'}
resB={}
for ln in pdb.split('\n'):
    if ln.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')) and ln[21]=='B' and ln[17:20].strip() in aa3to1:
        resB[int(ln[22:26])]=aa3to1[ln[17:20].strip()]
nums=sorted(resB); refseq=''.join(resB[n] for n in nums)

B62_raw=open('/dev/null').read() if False else None
import itertools
bl="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1

I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3

V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4""".split('\n')
cols=bl[0].split(); B62={}
for row in bl[1:]:
    p=row.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): B62[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); pY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1])
            o=(M[i-1,j-1],X[i-1,j-1],Y[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(o));M[i,j]=o[k]+s;pM[i,j]=k
            o=(M[i-1,j]+go,X[i-1,j]+ge,Y[i-1,j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(o));X[i,j]=o[k];pX[i,j]=k
            o=(M[i,j-1]+go,X[i,j-1]+go,Y[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(o));Y[i,j]=o[k];pY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax((M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m])));a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');ns=pX[i,j];i-=1
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1
        st=ns
        if i==0 and j==0: break
    return ''.join(reversed(a1)),''.join(reversed(a2))

SITES=[20,44,69,108,109,111,219]   # residues <4 A of the guanine base of GTP in 2FP4 chain B
table={}
for lab,seq in S.items():
    ar,aq=nw(refseq,seq); ip=iq=0; mp={}
    for c1,c2 in zip(ar,aq):
        if c1!='-': ip+=1
        if c2!='-': iq+=1
        if c1!='-' and c2!='-': mp[nums[ip-1]]=c2
    table[lab]={f'{refseq[nums.index(p)]}{p}b': mp.get(p,'-') for p in SITES}

spec={lab:s for lab,_,s,_ in PANEL}
df=pd.DataFrame(table).T
df.insert(0,'measured nucleotide use',[spec[l] for l in df.index])
pd.set_option('display.width',250)
print(df.to_string())
df.to_csv('scs_beta_specificity_sites.csv')

# ---- figure ----
sites=[c for c in df.columns if c!='measured nucleotide use']
labels=list(df.index)
colmap={'GTP-specific':'#2f6f4e','ATP-specific':'#8c3b3b','ADP-forming (ATP)':'#8c3b3b',
        'dual, prefers ADP/ATP':'#b07d3a','dual, prefers GDP/GTP':'#b07d3a','UNKNOWN':'#555555'}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,5.2))
for i,lab in enumerate(labels):
    for j,s in enumerate(sites):
        aa=df.loc[lab,s]
        ref=refseq[nums.index(int(s[1:-1]))]
        atp_ref=df.loc['pig SUCLA2 (A-SCS)',s]
        if aa==ref and aa!=atp_ref: fc='#cfe3d6'
        elif aa==atp_ref and aa!=ref: fc='#f0d2d2'
        elif aa==ref and aa==atp_ref: fc='#eeeeee'
        else: fc='#ffffff'
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j,-i),1,1,facecolor=fc,edgecolor='#999999',lw=0.6))
        ax.text(j+0.5,-i+0.5,aa,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=11,
                fontweight='bold' if s.endswith('20b') else 'normal')
ax.set_xlim(0,len(sites)); ax.set_ylim(-len(labels)+1,1)
ax.set_xticks([j+0.5 for j in range(len(sites))])
ax.set_xticklabels([s.replace('b','β') for s in sites],fontsize=10)
ax.set_yticks([-i+0.5 for i in range(len(labels))])
ax.set_yticklabels([f'{l}  [{spec[l]}]' for l in labels],fontsize=9)
for t,l in zip(ax.get_yticklabels(),labels): t.set_color(colmap[spec[l]])
ax.xaxis.set_ticks_position('top'); ax.xaxis.set_label_position('top')
ax.set_xlabel('Residues within 4.0 Å of the guanine base of GTP in pig G-SCS (PDB 2FP4, chain B)',fontsize=10)
for s in ax.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
ax.set_title('Only Gln20β separates measured ATP from GTP users;\nDictyostelium scsC has Pro20β, scsB has Gln20β',
             fontsize=12, pad=38)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
